craft_notes: Sthāyin: marvel at ladder-climbing gods. Device: comma held, end-dash→colon (scaling stated, lodging lands). Rejected: 'climb' for 'troops' — killed: troops marches upward, climb merely rises. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Up rung by rung even Brahmā troops with the rest,
thy stairway scaled, to lodge: to him I bow.
l4.sanskrit_cite: brahmādayo 'pi tad yasya karmasopānamālayā upary upari dhāvanti labdhuṃ dhāma namāmi tam

reads_against.argmap: Even Brahmā and others hasten higher and higher by his work-stair-series.; To win the abode: to him I bow. → I bow to him whose work-stair even Brahmā climbs.
c1_essence: Mere will fruits as three worlds; workings reach past knowing; work-stair climbed by Brahmā.
reads_against.l2: To him I bow, by whose stairway of works even Brahmā and the rest climb higher and higher to win the abode.
l3: Up rung by rung even Brahmā troops with the rest,
thy stairway scaled, to lodge — to him I bend.
